title: New World photo set: the thirteen gathering photos, optimized, with slot names and alt text

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: the real New World photo set; also closes the photo half of BLD-214

detail:
Thirteen owner-supplied photos (twelve JPEG, one HEIC converted) mapped onto the twelve slots the design names (circle-sunrise, garden-picnic, workshop-table, hands-up, group-hug, beach-joy, beach-move, beach-dance, backyard-class, beach-gong, fire-circle, fire-crew) plus one spare (cafe-table). Stored as webp under public/sites/new-world/photos (1.4 MB total, long edge at most 1600), with size, average colour and alt text in lib/sites/new-world-photos.json. Stand-alone site assets only (theme fence). Rights: owner-supplied by Daniel on 2026-11-03; the people shown have not been named or cleared, so treat as owner-asserted like LIVE-1910 until he confirms.

Thirteen photos optimized and mapped; test lib/sites/new-world-photos.test.ts.
